ideas.title: The $9B Minnesota Social Services Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $9B+ in fraud in Minnesota's social services programs, including the role of high-ranking officials and potential cover-ups.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore the impact on vulnerable populations
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and abuse of power in Minnesota's social services programs, with significant implications for taxpayers and vulnerable populations.
